phase_5_0_dual_track.regression_philosophy: Phase 4.2 bicycle is the regression reference, not ground truth. Expected 10-15% steady yaw difference due to wheel-level geometry and load-transfer fidelity.
known_limitations: No suspension compliance or roll dynamics
No ESC, torque vectoring, or differential model
Bicycle regression differences of approximately 10-15% in steady-state yaw are expected
